scope: Existing completed-friendly F1 read-only score/goal disclosure branch at three current widths
limits: Collector reports the current admin-access session; no account or role switch. No participant-specific UI or server-authorization test.
Recorded resultEntryLinkCount=0 and disabled application-button flags are UI measurements only; no permission conclusion.
No result reopen/edit, review posting, roster change, application, notification, save or other server-write action.
Score numbers extracted from the ends of the two displayed score-line sides; team/player names not retained.
Goal minute is DOM evidence. Public crops show only accordion controls, never player records.
Only click expansion/collapse tested; no screen-reader or full keyboard-flow certification.
Mobile proof row2 is a later observation of the same expanded state for the screenshot, not another cycle.
CUA action-call bounds are collector reports, not independent browser-event timestamps.
The profileLinkCount field applies only to the controlled goal region, not the whole page.
No goalkeeper/scorer identity, roster row, team name, or account data is included.
controlledRegionQueryBasis: Collector reports querying document.getElementById(button aria-controls); present is Boolean(region).
